messages:
ashwin: :rotating_light: alert from production: decode-stream pods in eu-west-1 showing sustained GPU memory growth and intermittent `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` starting ~00:00 UTC. Error rate up, some streams dropped. paging on-call.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-9821 triggered by latency/error budget breach (service: decode-stream). Severity: P2. Details: GPU mem > 95% on 6/8 pods, 5xx spike from streaming path.

marta: I see the same in dashboard — heap graph looks like a tail that never trims. Not typical KV cache growth. Looks like long generations growing beyond maxtokens. Could be prompt mismatch or SDK clients sending wrong token cap.

devon: Logs from pod decode-ev-7:
```
2026-03-15T00:00:12Z ERROR decode_executor: CUDA error: out of memory when allocating 2147483648 bytes
2026-03-15T00:00:12Z WARN runtime::stream: streaming request id=aa1b dropped after OOM
```

ashwin: How many distinct customers impacted? support-ops, can you surface tickets?

support-ops: Currently 3 customer escalation threads (acct:sunbeam, acct:edgetech, acct:marketai). All report partial responses or abrupt stream closures. Estimated 0.7% of overall host traffic in eu-west-1, but concentrated on a handful of high-token interactive bots.

ben: Stacktrace shows decode worker still trying to append tokens after EOS. Possible mismatch between SDK `maxGenerationTokens` and runtime `enforce_max_tokens` flag after the last config rollout.

marta: @devon can you confirm last config change? We rolled a prompt-routing tweak at 23:45 UTC.

devon: Confirmed. We also shipped a small defaults change in the streaming SDK mappers — it sets `max_tokens=null` if client provided `-1`. Looks like clients that used -1 are now uncontrolled.

ashwin: Ok mitigation plan:
- immediately pin the routing config to previous revision (rollback) to prevent new uncontrolled requests
- push a hotfix to runtime to treat `max_tokens <= 0` as a hard cap of 512 for streaming
- enable temporary per-tenant token enforcement in the gateway for high-volume tenants
- restart the 3 worst pods after draining

marta: I'm starting rollback now.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started: cfg/release-2026-03-15T23:30 -> cfg/release-2026-03-15T23:20. CI: passed quick smoke.

devon: Pushing runtime guard in staging now. Patch: `if client_max <= 0: client_max = min(512, default_max)`

ben: Also suggest toggling `prefix_kv_caching` off for eu-west decode nodes to free memory pressure while we stabilize.

support-ops: Noted. I'll open priority routing rule to throttle the 3 affected tenant API keys to 10 requests/sec per key until stable.

ashwin: Executed rollbacks + throttle. Now restarting pods one-by-one: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/decode-stream -l zone=eu-west-1 --grace-period=30` (drain on each before restart).

devon: Hotfix built and promoted to canary. Applying to 1 pod first.

marta: Canary pod passed 5m smoke with no OOM and normal token behavior. Applying to remaining pods now.

incident-bot: PD-9821 update: memory pressure dropping to 65% on average across cluster. Error rate trending down.

support-ops: Customer status: Sunbeam reports resumed normal stream behavior after ~8m interruption. MarketAI still has one active dropped session, asking for root cause and ETA.

ben: Root cause summary (preliminary): SDK change treating `-1` as unbounded combined with config rollout removed a runtime hard cap, leading to a small fraction of requests entering unbounded tail generation. That produced continuous KV growth and eventual CUDA OOM on decode GPUs.

ashwin: Mitigations completed: rollback, runtime hard-cap, per-tenant throttles, pod restarts. Next actions:
- postmortem capture tonight (owner: ben)
- release proper SDK patch and runtime enforcement in next release (owner: devon)
- notify affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps (owner: support-ops)
- add alert rule for sudden sustained token length growth per tenant

marta: Logging snippet for postmortem:
```
# sample from stacked request
request_id=aa1b, tenant=marketai, initial_prompt_len=140, requested_max_tokens=-1, observed_total_tokens=24832, decode_pod=decode-ev-7
```

support-ops: ETA for customer emails: 45m. I'll include affected request ids and what we did to mitigate. MarketAI ops wants a follow-up call.

devon: Patch merged to main: runtime now enforces `effective_max = clamp(client_max, 1, 4096)` and treats null as default 512 for streaming. SDK PR removing -1 passthrough merged too.

ben: Will own postmortem. I'll pull traces, attach flamegraphs for KV cache, and quantify memory delta vs token growth.

ashwin: Thanks all. Final status: incident resolved, cluster stable. Marking PD-9821 as resolved in 1h once customer comms sent. Follow-up tasks in tickets: INF-4578, INF-4579, INF-4580.

incident-bot: PD-9821 Status: Resolved (investigating followups). Duration: 00:11:52. Impact: partial request drops for ~3 customers, localized to eu-west-1 decode-stream nodes. Next: postmortem and release notes.

marta: quick note — add a canary rule for any config that touches token handling in future to prevent silent zero/null semantics.

ashwin: Agreed. Closing thread after postmortem is posted.
